annotation.interpretation_a: IANA must allocate the selected codepoint only if it is neither already assigned nor the first unallocated codepoint; if the codepoint is the first unallocated codepoint, IANA does not allocate it.
annotation.interpretation_b: IANA must allocate the selected codepoint unless it is already assigned; however, if the codepoint is the first unallocated codepoint, IANA must allocate it regardless of the "unless" clause.
annotation.justification: The clause uses "unless" in a way that could be read as applying to both conditions (already assigned or first unallocated) or only to the first condition (already assigned). The wording does not specify whether the first unallocated codepoint is an exception that requires allocation or an exception that prevents allocation, leaving the implementation ambiguous.
